tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page and window ground. Text on it: text, strong, muted. Text on a filled accent also uses bg (hover inversion).

tokens.name: surface-inset
tokens.usage: Inset ground: address bar, inputs, popups, sidebar, scrollbar track. Darker than bg in dark, white in light.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Section panels on the settings and list pages. Sits on bg.

tokens.name: surface-hover
tokens.usage: Hover ground for a setting row or list row on card.

tokens.name: surface-raised-hover
tokens.usage: Hover ground of a card on the Extensions page. Sits on card.

tokens.name: surface-active
tokens.usage: Active tab and active sidebar link ground. Text on it is pink2 (dark) or pink (light).

tokens.name: divider
tokens.usage: Section borders, dividers and the scrollbar edge. Decorative in the standard themes; a real 1px border in the contrast themes.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairline around list items and chips. It is muted at 28% alpha.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Body text on bg, bg2, card and row.

tokens.name: text-strong
tokens.usage: Titles of list items, tab tooltips and numbers that must stand out. On bg2 and card.

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, inactive icons and idle control borders on bg, bg2, card and row. At least 4.9:1 in dark and 5:1 in light. Also the placeholder colour.

tokens.name: text-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled glyphs only (about 2:1). Never carry meaning with it, and never use it for placeholders.

tokens.name: accent-primary
tokens.usage: Primary neon accent: primary buttons, the active tab outline and title, the brand's NEON, the divider under section titles. User-changeable (see accent presets). In light the app darkens any accent until it reaches 4.5:1 on every light surface (bg, bg2, card, row, tab); the value here is the default one. Not for errors or deletes: those use red.

tokens.name: accent-primary-soft
tokens.usage: Soft companion of pink: active tab and active sidebar link text. Derived from pink (lightened in dark, 82% of it in light). At least 6:1 on every surface in light.

tokens.name: accent-secondary
tokens.usage: Secondary neon accent: borders of fields and popups, links, input text, hover fills. User-changeable. Not for plain labels: setting names use strong. In light it is darkened like pink (4.6:1 on the darkest surface).

tokens.name: highlight
tokens.usage: Chrome highlights: brand wordmark, navigation buttons, numbers in the tab strip, section headings, the active download state. Light value is amber-800, at least 5.4:1 on every surface.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: On state of a toggle, success, the saved toast. In an incognito window the accent (pink) becomes green. Light value is at least 4.9:1 on every surface. Always paired with a word.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Danger: delete, clear and cancel actions, error text, BLOCK, the certificate warning. Outlined by default, filled on hover or when armed. Always paired with a word, never colour alone.

tokens.name: shadow
tokens.usage: Colour of popup drop shadows, written as `0 12px 28px var(--shadow)`. Transparent in the contrast themes.

tokens.name: scanline
tokens.usage: Colour of the CRT scanline overlay: `repeating-linear-gradient(0deg, transparent 0 2px, var(--scanline) 2px 3px)` on a fixed full-screen layer above everything, with pointer-events none.

tokens.name: surface-code
tokens.usage: Ground of the userscript code editor. Text on it is text.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: New tab page title. Cyan with a pink 3px offset shadow. The source scales it with clamp(28px, 5.2vw, 58px).

styles.name: display-lg
styles.usage: Page hero heading on internal pages, always uppercase, cyan with a pink 3px offset shadow.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Used when you type words instead of an address.
styles.usage: Default text on internal pages and the address field.

styles.name: chrome
styles.usage: Browser toolbar, tab titles and popups, where density matters.

styles.name: section-title
styles.usage: Section headings. Uppercase, yellow, with a pink hairline under it.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Toggle, nav link and badge text. Uppercase.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: URLs, tooltips and per-item metadata. Muted. 11px is the smallest size in NeonNet.

styles.name: micro
styles.usage: Status tags inside tabs, tooltips and the downloads popover. Uppercase and bold, never below 11px.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between tabs and between inline chips.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap inside a tab and between list items in a popup.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between toolbar controls and between buttons in a pair.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Toolbar and popup horizontal padding, and the gap in the top bar.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gap between a setting's label and its control.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Page side gutter on internal pages and the gap between sections.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Gap between the sidebar and the main column.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Every surface: buttons, fields, cards, popups, tabs. NeonNet has no rounded corners; corners are cut with clip-path instead (see cut tokens).

tokens.name: radius-count
tokens.usage: Only the round unread-count dot on the dock button.

cut.note: Corner cuts for clip-path polygons. Cut the top-right and bottom-left on large panels, the top-right on tabs, both on fields.

tokens.name: cut-sm
tokens.usage: Address bar, selects, text inputs and the GO button.

tokens.name: cut-tab
tokens.usage: Top-right of a tab.

tokens.name: cut-md
tokens.usage: Top-right of the sidebar and of the whole browser window.

tokens.name: cut-lg
tokens.usage: Top-right and bottom-left of the page hero.

tokens.name: z-tip
tokens.usage: Tab tooltip.

tokens.name: z-popup
tokens.usage: Toolbar popovers: zoom, downloads, tab list.

tokens.name: z-sticky
tokens.usage: Sticky top bar of internal pages.

tokens.name: z-scan
tokens.usage: Scanline overlay, above everything.

meta.note: Source of truth for NeonNet's colours, spacing, cuts and type. Run tools/gen_tokens.ps1 after editing: it writes ui/tokens.css.
